scope: free-choice patient-specific laboratory acquisition plus STOP

state_contract.observed_values: base values plus acquired candidate values; unknown slots are zero
state_contract.source_observation_mask: separate mask for source availability of observed values
state_contract.current_prediction: 3-year risk from the Cox model for the current subset

value_models.sample_strategy: one deterministic random subset of the other five candidates per train participant and candidate model
value_models.target: absolute 3-year risk revision |risk(S union candidate) - risk(S)| from train-fitted static baseline Cox subset models

adaptive_policy.name: adaptive_risk_revision_v1
adaptive_policy.utility: predicted absolute risk revision - cost_penalty * candidate cost
adaptive_policy.decision_rule: acquire the remaining candidate with maximum non-negative utility; choose STOP when every remaining utility is negative; force STOP after six
adaptive_policy.missing_result_rule: charge the selected action, retain the participant, use the train-fitted imputation value, and expose source absence through the source mask

tuning.cost_penalty_candidate_source: quantiles of train predicted benefit divided by primary-scheme cost
tuning.selection_metric: Harrell C-index retention relative to Base Only and Full Features
tuning.selection_rule: minimum mean primary-scheme cost among candidates retaining the target fraction of validation C-index improvement

evaluation.brier: single-horizon IPCW; censoring distribution estimated on train only

acquisition.missing_result_rule: charge the selected action; use the train-fitted imputation value; retain the participant and expose source availability through its mask

charge the requested action; use the train-fitted imputation value; retain the participant and continue normal NEXT/STOP evaluation
